summary: Verified P1 Forecast Data Sparsity Fix end-to-end. Backend regression suite (4/4) PASS plus 3 additional smoke tests PASS. Frontend dashboard now shows populated 12-month Revenue & Shipment Trend, 30 dense Demand Forecast bars, and NETWORK REVENUE ₦547.2M with +13.0% growth. Intelligence Center stockout forecasts card renders all 4 urgency filter buttons with count badges (critical 8 · high 12 · medium 193 · low 626 = 839 tracked), auto-defaults to the critical bucket (8 rows, no empty state), and filter switching to LOW correctly loads 30 rows. All success criteria met.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend tests verify both /manufacturer/{id}/overview (revenue_trend & demand_forecast.bars) and /intel/forecasts/stockout (urgency_counts) work as designed.
Regression sweep on product-intelligence sparkline_30d (units field fix) returns non-zero values for portfolio rows — no regression introduced by quantity_sold → units fallback.

Frontend dashboard chart correctly switches to 12M and displays 12 dense monthly buckets (Jul through Jun) with forecast overlay; all bars in the 30-day demand forecast are positive and properly sized.
IntelligenceCenter ForecastsCard smart-default logic working: lands on highest-priority non-empty bucket (critical) instead of the empty placeholder.
seed_data_creation: None — used the pre-existing backfill from main agent (530,509 historical daily_sales rows).
context_for_next_testing_agent: P1 forecast sparsity fix is verified. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_forecast_density.py (4 cases) and /app/backend/tests/test_forecast_density_extra.py (3 cases) cover the regression. Use mfr_id=b21c1dbe-1a6f-4c33-b036-f416579455d0 for Unilever. data-testids on IntelligenceCenter forecast card: forecast-filter-{critical|high|medium|low}, forecast-total-count, forecast-row, forecast-empty.
rca of the issue: Sparse forecast data was caused by (a) only ~90 days of daily_sales rows existing in db, (b) routes querying legacy `quantity_sold` field instead of canonical `units`, (c) IntelligenceCenter ForecastsCard defaulting to 'critical' filter even when bucket was empty. Fix: backfilled 12 months of daily_sales (530k rows), added `units` fallback across manufacturer/distributor/product_intelligence routes, exposed urgency_counts in /api/intel/forecasts/stockout, and added smart-default to highest-priority non-empty bucket in ForecastsCard.
